reason: The original iPhone 11 Pro smoke timed out downloading the pinned GGUF before inference. A separate bundled-delivery package removes that network dependency from inference measurements while retaining the failed remote-acquisition evidence.

artifact.delivery: Read-only application bundle, verified by the existing ModelStore size and SHA-256 checks before timing. No model acquisition network request in the selected smoke or study methods.

controls.nativeEngine: Reuse the hash-verified existing GGUF-only iOS 16.6 native archives without rebuilding or changing the shared engine.
controls.fixtures: Unchanged S1-S3 workload bytes and original strict graders.
controls.decoding: greedy, thinking off, repeat penalty disabled
controls.sourceIsolation: Copy the registered benchmark inputs into a separate build directory. Only the GGUF manifest delivery and runtime variant/measurement disclosure change in that copy. Existing canonical sources and all historical products remain unchanged.

gates: Verify pinned weight bytes and SHA-256 before building and inside the signed package.
Retain signed Xcode 26.2 build, minimum OS, source-before/after receipt, native archive hashes, exact selected plans and immutable source/package snapshots.
Validate exact smoke and S1 packages on the local iPhone before any new older-device cloud job.
Obtain fresh concrete paid-execution approval. No current approval covers an older-device retry.
Require successful actual older-OS smoke inference before expanding that older-device cohort.
analysis: Record benchmarkVariant=gguf-ios16.6-bundled-v1 in raw runtimeVersions so analysis never pools this variant with remote-delivery or full-framework packages.
Bundled delivery does not prove the original remote acquisition timeout or subsequent infrastructure failures are fixed.
Verify actual cloud OS after execution. Hardware, OS, delivery and lab conditions may differ, so no hardware-only causal claim follows.
Keep every original seven-runtime/three-device/three-scenario requirement. Older GGUF coverage is supplemental and cannot replace missing delegate or SE 3 cells.
